summary: Computes the averaged position of all elements in a packed array, lerps it with the bounding-box center using a blend factor (0.35 when mode a2 == 2, otherwise 0.70), adds a three-field offset queried from the scene state, writes the three fields back, and finishes by applying the computed offset vector to the object at a1. On the frame path; used by audio and vehicle subsystems.

Initialize the three component accumulators v14, v16, v18 to 0.0.
Call LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230(0) to obtain the linked-list node representing the packed array.
Call PackedArrayTotalSize(v3) to get the element count v4 of the packed array.
Guard on v4 > 0: only when the packed array is non-empty do the sum-and-average and the count-derived scaling.
do-while over v5 in [0, v4): call PackedArrayIndexLookup(v5++) to get each element pointer v6 and accumulate its three components into v14, v16, v18.
Average the three sums: v14 *= 1.0 / v4, v16 *= 1.0 / v4, v18 *= 1.0 / v4.
Guard on a2 == 2: select blend factor v8 = 0.35 (mode 2) else v8 = 0.70.
Lerp box center and averaged position: v28 = v14 * (1.0 - v8), v29 = v16 * (1.0 - v8), v23 = v22 * v8, v15 = v20 * v8 + v28, v17 = v21 * v8 + v29, v19 = v23 + (1.0 - v8) * v18.
Call TripleFieldQuery(&v24, &v25, &v26) to read the three current X/Y/Z field values.
Combine the lerped components with the queried fields: v10 = v15 + v24, v11 = v17 + v25, v12 = v19 + v26.
Call ThreeFieldSetterWithSubCall with the low dwords of v10, v11, v12 to write the three combined fields.
Return GlobalVectorOffsetUpdate(a1, &v28) which applies the computed offset vector to the object at a1.
